summary: Iteration 4 (PDF quality + PDF status-bar + AI plain-text). Backend: 25/25 passing (100%) — added 2 new tests (TestAIPlainText) for /api/ai/solution and /api/ai/chat which assert no '**' Markdown bold, no LaTeX backslashes (excluding JSON-escaped \n/\t/\r/\"), no '#' heading lines. All 23 prior regression tests still green. Frontend code-level review (grep + view): (a) src/pdf-html.ts:61 declares `outputScale = Math.max(2, window.devicePixelRatio || 2)` and line 89 passes `transform = [outputScale, 0, 0, outputScale, 0, 0]` into page.render — Retina-sharp rendering confirmed. Container width Math.min(innerWidth-24, 1100) also confirmed. (b) app/pdf.tsx root is now `<View style={styles.root} testID='pdf-viewer'>` (NOT SafeAreaView), and line 110 header has `paddingTop: insets.top + spacing.sm` on the white bg — status-bar strip is covered. (c) app/(tabs)/ai.tsx line 108 renders `m.role === 'user' ? m.content : humanize(m.content)` — humanize applied ONLY to assistant, user messages passthrough. (d) src/format.ts:45 exports `humanize(input: string): string`; regex table handles \int→∫, \frac{a}{b}→(a)/(b), \sqrt{x}→√(x), Greek letters, superscripts x^2→x², subscripts, ** bold stripping, # heading stripping, backtick code stripping — spot-checked correctness of the mapping. (e) app/pdf.tsx:74 TTS calls `humanize(solution.narration || ...)` — narration is cleaned before expo-speech.speak(). Frontend runtime validation on mobile viewport 390x844: Welcome shows 'GCSHARP' + 'Global Classroom Sharpening Potentials' ✓. Logged in as student, sent 'Explain derivative of x^3 + 2x using power rule' — assistant bubble rendered fully plain-text with Unicode math (x³, xⁿ, x², ·, ⁰, ¹), 0 occurrences of '**', 0 backslashes, 0 leading '#' — verified via document scraping of testid msg-1. ONE FRONTEND MISS: app/pdf.tsx lines 231-232 render `{s.heading}` and `{s.body}` in the solution-steps ScrollView WITHOUT wrapping in humanize(), even though the review request explicitly says 'pdf.tsx renders solution.steps with humanize(s.heading) and humanize(s.body)'. Backend prompt already instructs plain-text so this is a defence-in-depth miss (not user-visible today because /api/ai/solution came back clean), but it should be added to match the spec + protect against future prompt drift.
